security_capabilities_verified: Secure session lifecycle management (startSession, stopSession, getSession, getQrCode) with isolated credentials via ISigningSecretResolver and fail-closed validation on missing API key

Robust single-read QR code parsing supporting JSON (qr/raw), plain text, SVG, PNG/JPEG/WebP data URIs, payload size enforcement (512KB), typed rejections (WAHA_UNSUPPORTED_QR_FORMAT), and zero credential leakage
Outbound media dispatch routed to dedicated endpoints (/api/sendImage, /api/sendVideo, /api/sendVoice, /api/sendFile, /api/sendText)

SSRF static perimeter guard on WAHA base URLs (rejecting embedded user credentials, alternative/octal/dword/hex IP notation, cloud metadata 169.254.169.254/metadata.google.internal, direct private/reserved IPv4 and IPv6 in production, enforcing HTTPS in production with strict Docker lab/allowlist separation; dynamic DNS resolution, redirect intercept, and DNS rebinding pinning are applied to media download streams via CH-07 downloadMediaStream)
In-flight fencing abort rethrowing FENCING_IN_FLIGHT_ABORT when params.signal?.aborted triggers during dispatch or session calls

Deterministic HTTP status classification (transient 429 with parsed Retry-After, 502/503/504; permanent 404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND, 4xx, API_KEY_REQUIRED; ambiguous 408, 425, EMPTY_MESSAGE_ID, network timeout)
Session lifecycle webhook normalization (session.status, session.qr, session.auth_failure) generating canonical lifecycle events (connected, disconnected, qr_received, auth_failure)
Accurate inbound media detection via detectMediaType(payload.mediaUrl) classifying audio, video, document, and image
Delivery status normalization for positive ACKs (sent, delivered, read) and negative ACKs (ack: -1 -> failed) with versioned externalEventId
Isolated docker-compose profile ('waha') preserving hermetic test baselines

acceptance_criteria.evidence: WahaAdapter implementa startSession, stopSession, getSession e getQrCode com segredos isolados estritamente dentro de ISigningSecretResolver, leitura única do payload de QR e fail-closed sem API key.

WahaAdapter despacha mídias para endpoints dedicados (/api/sendImage, /api/sendVideo, /api/sendVoice, /api/sendFile) com validação defensiva contra SSRF em URLs de mídia e guarda perimétrica em baseUrl.
WahaAdapter relança FENCING_IN_FLIGHT_ABORT em caso de cancelamento/perda de lease e classifica deterministamente 404, 429 com Retry-After, 502/503/504 e 408/425.
WahaWebhookNormalizer normaliza eventos session.status, session.qr e session.auth_failure em eventos canônicos do tipo lifecycle.
WahaWebhookNormalizer detecta acuradamente mídias inbound (áudio, vídeo, documento, imagem) e normaliza ACKs negativos como status failed.
Serviço waha configurado em docker-compose.yml sob profiles: ['waha'], garantindo isolamento hermético do ambiente padrão de CI.
Suítes de adaptadores (59 testes) e gateway (51 testes) totalizam 110 asserções aprovadas; 27 suítes do monorepo (404 asserções) e 6 gates de CI homologados com sucesso.
